hook.en: Malaysia's rainforests are among the oldest on Earth — over 100 million years old by some estimates — yet large areas have been cleared in just a few decades.
hook.bm: Hutan hujan Malaysia antara yang tertua di dunia — lebih 100 juta tahun menurut sesetengah anggaran — namun kawasan yang luas telah ditebang dalam beberapa dekad sahaja.

bigIdeas.en: Main types: tropical rainforest (lowland, hill and upper dipterocarp, then montane forest), mangrove, freshwater and peat swamp, and beach forest.
bigIdeas.bm: Jenis utama: hutan hujan tropika (dipterokarpa tanah pamah, bukit dan atas, kemudian hutan pergunungan), paya bakau, paya air tawar dan paya gambut, serta hutan pantai.

bigIdeas.en: Climate, relief, soil and drainage explain their distribution.
bigIdeas.bm: Iklim, bentuk muka bumi, tanih dan saliran menerangkan taburannya.

bigIdeas.en: Forests give oxygen, habitats, water catchments, timber and medicine; clearing them causes erosion, floods and loss of species.
bigIdeas.bm: Hutan membekalkan oksigen, habitat, kawasan tadahan air, kayu balak dan ubat; penebangan menyebabkan hakisan, banjir dan kehilangan spesies.

cells.en: Tall trees, many layers, very rich in species
cells.bm: Pokok tinggi, banyak lapisan, sangat kaya spesies

cells.en: Short trees, moss, ferns, pitcher plants
cells.bm: Pokok rendah, lumut, paku-pakis, periuk kera
Pantai berlumpur dan terlindung (cth. Matang, Perak)
Akar pernafasan dan akar jangkang, tahan masin

cells.en: Low, waterlogged areas (large areas in Sarawak)
cells.bm: Kawasan rendah bertakung air (kawasan luas di Sarawak)

definition.en: A family of tall rainforest trees with two-winged seeds, e.g. meranti and keruing.
definition.bm: Keluarga pokok hutan hujan yang tinggi dengan biji bersayap dua, cth. meranti dan keruing.

definition.en: The tallest trees that rise above the canopy.
definition.bm: Pokok tertinggi yang menjulang melebihi silara.

definition.en: The dense layer of tree crowns.
Mangrove roots that grow upward to take in air.
definition.bm: Akar bakau yang tumbuh ke atas untuk menyedut udara.

definition.en: Forested area that collects and supplies water to rivers and dams.
definition.bm: Kawasan berhutan yang mengumpul dan membekalkan air kepada sungai dan empangan.

question.en: Explain how mangrove trees are adapted to their environment.
question.bm: Terangkan penyesuaian pokok bakau terhadap persekitarannya.

steps.en: The mud has little oxygen → breathing roots (pneumatophores) grow up into the air.
steps.bm: Lumpur kurang oksigen → akar pernafasan tumbuh ke udara.

steps.en: Soft mud and tides → stilt (prop) roots support the tree.
steps.bm: Lumpur lembut dan pasang surut → akar jangkang menyokong pokok.

steps.en: Salty water → leaves can tolerate or remove salt.
steps.bm: Air masin → daun boleh bertahan atau menyingkirkan garam.

answer.en: Breathing roots, stilt roots and salt tolerance.
answer.bm: Akar pernafasan, akar jangkang dan ketahanan terhadap garam.

prompt.en: The main type of natural vegetation in Malaysia is…
prompt.bm: Jenis utama tumbuh-tumbuhan semula jadi di Malaysia ialah…

explanation.en: It is hot and wet all year.
explanation.bm: Panas dan lembap sepanjang tahun.

prompt.en: Mangrove forests grow on…
prompt.bm: Hutan paya bakau tumbuh di…

explanation.en: e.g. the Matang mangroves in Perak.

prompt.en: Meranti and keruing are examples of…
prompt.bm: Meranti dan keruing ialah contoh pokok…

explanation.en: Valuable timber trees.
explanation.bm: Pokok balak yang bernilai.

prompt.en: Rhu (casuarina) trees are typical of…
prompt.bm: Pokok rhu ialah ciri…

explanation.en: They grow on sandy coasts.
explanation.bm: Ia tumbuh di pantai berpasir.

prompt.en: Mangrove roots that grow upwards to take in air are called ______ roots.

explanation.en: Stilt roots give support.

prompt.en: Which factor causes montane forest to replace dipterocarp forest on high mountains?
prompt.bm: Faktor manakah menyebabkan hutan pergunungan menggantikan hutan dipterokarpa di gunung tinggi?

explanation.en: Altitude changes the climate.
explanation.bm: Altitud mengubah iklim.

options.bm: Suhu lebih rendah di altitud tinggi
Lebih banyak hujan di aras laut

prompt.en: Forests act as water catchment areas, which means they…
prompt.bm: Hutan berfungsi sebagai kawasan tadahan air, bermaksud ia…

explanation.en: Many dams depend on forested catchments.
explanation.bm: Banyak empangan bergantung pada kawasan tadahan berhutan.

options.en: collect and release water steadily to rivers and dams
options.bm: mengumpul dan melepaskan air secara berterusan ke sungai dan empangan

prompt.en: Clearing forests on slopes often leads to…
prompt.bm: Penebangan hutan di cerun sering menyebabkan…

explanation.en: Roots no longer hold the soil.
explanation.bm: Akar tidak lagi memegang tanih.

prompt.en: Arrange the rainforest layers from TOP to BOTTOM.
prompt.bm: Susun lapisan hutan hujan dari ATAS ke BAWAH.

explanation.en: Less light reaches the lower layers.
explanation.bm: Kurang cahaya sampai ke lapisan bawah.

prompt.en: Match each forest type with its typical location.
prompt.bm: Padankan jenis hutan dengan lokasinya.

explanation.en: Altitude and drainage decide the type.
explanation.bm: Altitud dan saliran menentukan jenisnya.

prompt.en: Select ALL importance of natural vegetation.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA kepentingan tumbuh-tumbuhan semula jadi.

explanation.en: Forests also produce oxygen and attract tourists.
explanation.bm: Hutan juga menghasilkan oksigen dan menarik pelancong.

prompt.en: How do mangrove forests protect coastal areas?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah hutan paya bakau melindungi kawasan pantai?

explanation.en: They also act as fish nurseries.
explanation.bm: Ia juga menjadi tempat pembiakan ikan.

options.en: Their roots reduce wave energy and trap mud, preventing erosion
options.bm: Akarnya mengurangkan tenaga ombak dan memerangkap lumpur, mencegah hakisan

prompt.en: Which human activity MOST threatens peat swamp forests?
prompt.bm: Kegiatan manusia manakah PALING mengancam hutan paya gambut?

explanation.en: Dry peat can burn and cause haze.
explanation.bm: Gambut kering boleh terbakar dan menyebabkan jerebu.

prompt.en: Peat swamp forest grows on low, ______ land.
prompt.bm: Hutan paya gambut tumbuh di kawasan rendah yang ______ air.

explanation.en: Poor drainage causes peat to build up.
explanation.bm: Saliran yang buruk menyebabkan gambut terkumpul.

prompt.en: Why can deforestation increase flash floods?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah penebangan hutan boleh meningkatkan banjir kilat?

explanation.en: Eroded soil also fills rivers (sedimentation).
explanation.bm: Tanih terhakis juga memenuhi sungai (pemendapan).

options.en: Less water is absorbed, so more runs off quickly into rivers
options.bm: Kurang air diserap, jadi lebih banyak air larian mengalir dengan cepat ke sungai

prompt.en: Why do lowland rainforests have the greatest variety of species in Malaysia?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah hutan hujan tanah pamah mempunyai kepelbagaian spesies tertinggi di Malaysia?

explanation.en: Ideal conditions for growth all year.
explanation.bm: Keadaan sesuai untuk pertumbuhan sepanjang tahun.

options.en: Warm temperatures, high rainfall and fertile, well-drained soil
options.bm: Suhu panas, hujan tinggi dan tanih subur yang bersaliran baik

prompt.en: A hillside forest near a town is cleared for housing. Predict TWO likely effects.
prompt.bm: Hutan di lereng bukit berhampiran bandar dibersihkan untuk perumahan. Ramalkan DUA kesan yang mungkin.

explanation.en: Slope protection and drainage are needed.
explanation.bm: Perlindungan cerun dan sistem saliran diperlukan.

options.en: Landslides and muddy rivers from erosion
options.bm: Tanah runtuh dan sungai berkeladak akibat hakisan
Lebih banyak hidupan liar dan udara lebih bersih
Suhu lebih rendah dan kurang banjir

prompt.en: Why are forests important in reducing global warming?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah hutan penting dalam mengurangkan pemanasan global?

explanation.en: Burning forests releases stored carbon.
explanation.bm: Pembakaran hutan membebaskan karbon yang tersimpan.

options.en: Trees absorb carbon dioxide and store carbon
options.bm: Pokok menyerap karbon dioksida dan menyimpan karbon

options.en: Trees release more carbon dioxide than cars
options.bm: Pokok membebaskan lebih karbon dioksida daripada kereta

prompt.en: Why is montane forest important even though it has little timber value?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah hutan pergunungan penting walaupun nilai kayu balaknya rendah?

explanation.en: Many rivers begin in highlands.
explanation.bm: Banyak sungai bermula di tanah tinggi.

options.en: It protects water catchments and rare species and prevents erosion on steep slopes
options.bm: Ia melindungi kawasan tadahan air dan spesies jarang serta mencegah hakisan di cerun curam

prompt.en: Which action BEST balances development and forest conservation?
prompt.bm: Tindakan manakah PALING mengimbangi pembangunan dan pemuliharaan hutan?

explanation.en: This is sustainable development.
explanation.bm: Ini pembangunan lestari.

options.en: Selective logging, replanting and protecting catchments and steep slopes
options.bm: Pembalakan terpilih, penanaman semula dan melindungi kawasan tadahan serta cerun curam

options.en: Banning all use of forests forever
